title: Mixing: Wings Over America by Wings | 1976
content:
Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tom Walsh

Wings finished mixing the live album Wings Over America on 20 November 1976.

On this day, the last of 13 mixing sessions, the song ‘Soily’ was worked on. It had been recorded on 7 June 1976 at the McNichols Sports Arena in Denver.

Page last updated: 16 January 2026
